# Family Office Institute Hong Kong

> Official public-content index for Family Office Institute Hong Kong (FOIHK), a Hong Kong family office industry institution and professional community. This file aids discovery but does not replace canonical HTML, sources, or structured data.

## Organization

- Display name: Family Office Institute Hong Kong
- Legal name: Family Office Institute Hong Kong Limited
- Traditional Chinese name: 香港家族辦公室學會
- Short name: FOIHK
- Founded: 2025-08-20
- Website: https://www.foihk.org
- Email: info@foihk.org
- Address: 32/F, The Center, 99 Queen's Road Central, Central, Hong Kong, HK
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/foihk

FOIHK publishes educational, research, news, event, and philanthropy information for the Hong Kong family office ecosystem. Website content is general information, not investment, legal, tax, accounting, or other regulated professional advice.
